prompt: Compose an email asking a former teammate whether they would be comfortable sharing a few practical tips with a newcomer to the group. A response of around 120 words is enough.
text:
Subject: Quick Request for Advice

Hi [Name],

I hope you’re doing well. I’m reaching out because we have a newcomer joining our group, and I was wondering whether you’d be comfortable sharing a few practical tips with them. Your experience and perspective would be especially helpful as they get familiar with the team, our processes, and day-to-day work.

Nothing formal is required—perhaps a brief conversation or a few suggestions by email, whichever is easiest for you. Of course, please don’t feel any pressure if your schedule is full or you’d rather not. I thought of you because you always had a practical understanding of how things worked.

Thanks for considering it, and I hope all is well.

Best,  
[Your Name]
